Solution / Key Steps: Use r = sum[(x-xbar)(y-ybar)] / sqrt(sum(x-xbar)^2 sum(y-ybar)^2). Here xbar=4 and ybar=8.8, giving r≈0.993. The variables have a very strong positive linear association.
